name: Thorn Beakpick
description: Stand with both heads of the hammer ready like a court of two ready to rule on each blow.

name: Brutalizing Anvilfall
description: Rap the foe with one head then its twin in a quick matched pair at the same plate.

name: Gust Hammerblow
description: Take two matched paces so the paired heads arrive on the beat of each foot.

name: Titanic Tamp
description: Land both heads in matched time with qi so the second crushes what the first has cracked.

name: Gust Hammerface
description: Take a cut on one head and turn it away while the other head rises to answer.

name: Tampdurance
description: Hook the rear head behind a raised guard and haul it down for the front head to strike.

name: Unsparing Clawside
description: Drop first one head and then the other in two heavy qi-fed falls upon the same guard.

name: Brutalizing Spikeback
description: Press with both heads on two sides of a foe's guard and hold with qi until it splits.

name: Lacerating Anvilback
description: Let two matched blows fall in one beat so the first breaks the guard and the second the body.

name: Peennerve
description: Stand with weight held at the edge of the feet like water at the rim of a basin.

name: Rumble Cheekplate
description: Rap the rim of the foe's plate to find where its strength gathers.

name: Hogtying Eyehole
description: Scoop the beak under a shield rim and lift it to leave the chest open.

name: Peenglare
description: Step low and flat along the ground so force gathers in the legs before the swing.

name: Gustsmith
description: Strike again and again at the same dent with qi so it deepens like a basin.

name: Murk Faceplate
description: Let a blow run over the haft like water over a rim and spill past the body.

name: Punishing Peenbite
description: Pour the gathered qi into the head in one tilting swing that crushes helm and crown.

name: Intentforge
description: Press the face on a guard while qi floods the armor until the plates buckle under the weight.

name: Silt Forge
description: Slam the hammer down so the basin of qi spills outward and staggers every armored foe near.

name: Devastating Rumble Spikeback
description: Pour the full basin of qi through the spike in one thrust that pierces the thickest plate.

name: Smithvalor
description: Hold the hammer high and wide as if poised in the open sky above the foe.

name: Blistering Hammerneck
description: Rap down from a raised arm to draw the foe's guard high before the real fall.

name: Tampspine
description: Hook the beak over a raised blade and pull it out to the side while the haft rises.

name: Granite Peenside
description: Step along the line of the foe's shoulders to hold a high angle for the swing.

name: Flintlike Faceplate
description: Hold the haft calm and level so a blow slides off like wind over a smooth sky.

name: Anvilfall Wrath
description: Drop the hammer from full height with qi so that the whole fall lands in the head.

name: Sanguine Hammerblow
description: Pitch the head upward and over at the peak of a leap so it drops on the helm.

name: Mastering Cheekplate
description: Pull a foe forward off balance with the beak so that he stumbles under the coming fall.

name: Gnashing Peenside
description: Leap and descend with a field of qi gathered above so the hammer lands with the height's weight.

name: Charter Forge
description: Hold the hammer above the foe and press down with qi so the air itself bears on him.

name: Gnashing Hammerface Ruin
description: Fall from the greatest height of qi with the spike leading so that plate shatters under the point.

name: Thorn Clawside
description: Stand with force flowing down both legs like paired rivers meeting in the haft.

name: Gnashing Tamp
description: Tap the foe with the head as its mate follows from the poll an instant later.

name: Torrent Anvilback
description: Step first to one side then the other of the foe like a river running between two banks.

name: Hammerneck Reckoning
description: Send two qi flows down the haft that arrive in the head at the same instant.

name: Chime Eyehole
description: Meet an enemy blow where both flows join and turn it into a spiraling rush away from you.

name: Hammerblow Tenacity
description: Hook the beak between two guards and part them like a stream split by a stone.

name: Gust Clawside
description: Bring both flows of qi onto the face of the head so the blow crushes plate and shield together.

name: Ponderous Peenside
description: Wind the haft about a foe's weapon arm and hold it fast with two steady flows of qi.

name: Forgewrath
description: Drive both paired flows into one falling blow that sunders the foe's guard and the armor behind it.

name: Inexorable Spikeback
description: Hold the haft with body force in one hand and qi in the other so both tracks cover the front.

name: Ferocious Faceplate
description: Rap with strength from the left arm alone to open the foe's guard.

name: Peenbite Devastation
description: Rap with qi from the right arm alone to follow the left track where it landed.

name: Blinding Drivehome
description: Switch footing so the body track and the qi track change sides in a single step.

name: Waningsmith
description: Pause and feel both tracks to learn which of them the foe is guarding poorly.

name: Anvilhavoc
description: Cross the body track and qi track in the haft so the blow lands with both.

name: Torrent Beakpick
description: Meet a blow with the strength of the body and turn it with a pulse of qi.

name: Mayhemtamp
description: Hook the beak between the foe's two hands and split his grip on his weapon.

name: Tempered Hammerface
description: Press down on both tracks at once and crush a guard with the joined force.

name: Gnashing Drivehome
description: Rush in with body strength and qi driving the hammer on two tracks into one blow.

name: Gyveanvil
description: Lock a foe's weapon under the head and hold both tracks down until his arm tires.

name: Gnashing Beakpick Reckoning
description: Join the two tracks fully in the haft and loose them in one blow that crushes steel.

name: Thorn Cheekplate
description: Sink the feet into the ground like silt settling and hold the hammer steady above the knees.

name: Granite Anvilfall
description: Rap the foe's plate with the dead weight of the head like a stone settling on a bed.

name: Lightning Eyehole
description: Move in slow steady paces so the foe cannot judge when the hammer will fall.

name: Shattering Peenbite
description: Load the head with a dense layer of qi so the blow lands like heavy wet silt.

name: Equipoise Hammerneck
description: Drop the head like a stone on an attacking blade and bear it down to the ground.

name: Anvilspine
description: Drag the beak along the ground to hook a foe's ankle and pull his footing away.

name: Booming Drivehome
description: Lay the head down on a foe's guard and add qi until he is pinned like a stone on silt.

name: Tamp Hardihood
description: Bear down on both of a foe's feet with the haft so that he sinks and cannot step.

name: Ironforge
description: Drive the whole settled weight of the stance into one blow that grinds steel to the ground.

name: Aegissmith
description: Stand with one hand high and one low on the haft like two hawks on two perches.

name: Blaze Anvilfall
description: Reach out with the beak and tap the foe to fix his eyes before the fall.

name: Might Eyehole
description: Step as if to fall in from the left then slip right as the hammer drops.

name: Inexorable Anvilback
description: Turn a blow with the lower hand while the upper hand lifts the head for an answer.

name: Smithruin
description: Reach with the beak to pin the guard and fall with the face upon the open flank.

name: Rumble Forge
description: Catch a foe's weapon with the beak and the butt spike together and wrench it free.

name: Peenbite Wrath
description: Strike with the forward head as the rear hand adds its full pull for a crushing blow.

name: Ironpeen
description: Dive upon the foe from both reach and height so the hammer lands a second time on the first dent.

name: Tamp Havoc
description: Spread both arms and press down on the foe's weapon with steady qi so it cannot be raised.

name: Ferocious Anvilback
description: Dive with reach and fall joined so the spike shatters a plate and drives into the body beneath.

name: Peenvalor
description: Hold the haft upright along the line from the legs to the head so a blow meets the whole line.

name: Mightpeen
description: Tap the foe's guard with the head and feel the line of force run back down to the heels.

name: Chime Cheekplate
description: Hook the beak and pull without breaking the line from heel to head so the foe is dragged forward.

name: Meteoric Beakpick
description: Step so that the line of force from the legs to the head is never broken.

name: Remnant Peenside
description: Pause to read where the foe's own line of force breaks and where it holds.

name: Grievous Forge
description: Send qi in an unbroken line from the soles into the head and land the blow along it.

name: Torrent Hammerneck
description: Hold the line while the haft turns a blow so the force runs harmlessly down to the ground.

name: Hellish Hammerface
description: Crush a guard with a blow carried along the full line from the basin of the hips.

name: Mayhem Drivehome
description: Drag a hooked foe along the line of your own force until he loses his balance.

name: Might Cheekplate
description: Drop the hammer along an unbroken line of qi from ground to head to crack the foe's plate.

name: Fastening Spikeback
description: Press the head onto a foe along the line and hold so his weapon cannot leave his side.

name: Dismantling Faceplate
description: Sweep the hammer along the line at waist height so foes standing along it are thrown aside.

name: Iron Clawside
description: Carry one unbroken line of force from the basin of the legs through the haft to the head in one blow.

name: Unbudging Eyehole
description: Stand with the feet set as if sworn to the ground and the hammer ready to carry through.

name: Might Faceplate
description: Tap the foe's weapon edge with the head to mark the line the blow will follow.

name: Siltpeen
description: Walk the rim of the foe's reach in even paces and never let the hammer drop.

name: Blaze Peenside
description: Crush at the edge of a shield with qi so the blow cannot be turned from its mark.

name: Beakpick Mettle
description: Hold the sworn stance and turn a cut with the haft so the line of the blow is not lost.

name: Webbing Clawside
description: Hook the beak into a foe's belt or strap and pull him onto the line of the blow.

name: Anvilback Devastation
description: Carry a falling blow to its sworn mark whatever the foe's guard may do in between.

name: Granite Hammerblow
description: Hold the head against a guard under qi and keep pressing until the oath of the blow is kept.

name: Glint Anvilfall
description: Drive the spike on its sworn line so plate and guard alike break and the oath is fulfilled.

name: Thornpeen
description: Stand open to the wind with the hammer low and the weight settled for a heavy swing.

name: Rampaging Hammerface
description: Tap the foe's guard to open a path for the heavy swing that follows.

name: Forge Nerve
description: Hook the beak into the wind's push and pull a foe's weapon with it.

name: Torrential Drivehome
description: Step back along the arc of the swing so the hammer returns to guard on the wind.

name: Forgescourge
description: Swing the heavy head with the wind behind it and qi in it so it lands very hard.

name: Inexorable Hammerneck
description: Turn the swing of the hammer into a guard that throws a cut aside on the wind.

name: Lacerating Tamp
description: Crush down with qi and the wind together so the helm gives under the weight.

name: Downpour Spikeback
description: Swing the heavy hammer in a full circle on the wind so every foe in reach is struck.

name: Thornsmith
description: Press the head onto a foe's weapon and let the wind and qi hold it there.

name: Eviscerating Beakpick
description: Complete one great swing of qi and wind that lands on the bearing and breaks all it meets.

name: Hoarfrost Eyehole
description: Take a bearing on the foe's centre and hold the hammer ready along that line.

name: Smithwrath
description: Tap lightly along the bearing to draw the foe's guard onto it.

name: Mastering Clawside
description: Catch a foe's weapon with the beak as it crosses the bearing and hold it there.

name: Mighttamp
description: Step so that the bearing on the foe is kept whichever way he moves.

name: Smithrespite
description: Pause to fix the bearing once more and sense when the foe shifts from it.

name: Shattering Forge
description: Drive the head along the bearing with qi so nothing in the line can stop it.

name: Murk Anvilback
description: Turn a cut away without letting the bearing slip off the foe's centre.

name: Eviscerating Peenbite
description: Beat along the bearing in a hard rhythm until the foe's guard on it collapses.

name: Drivehome Devastation
description: Fall along the bearing with the whole weight of the hammer and break the guard that stands on it.

name: Ponderous Hammerneck
description: Press with qi along the bearing until the foe's whole stance bends toward the ground.

name: Rumble Peenside
description: Drive the spike along the bearing so plate and body alike are shattered all along the line.

name: Anvilmettle
description: Stand at the open edge with the hammer low and the wind pressing at your back.

name: Tempered Peenbite
description: Tap at the foe's shield edge and watch how his feet answer the sound.

name: Forgeflash
description: Run along the edge of the foe's reach to find an angle the hammer may fall from.

name: Spikeback Reckoning
description: Strike from the open edge with qi so the blow comes in on the foe's weak side.

name: Anvilvalor
description: Let the wind turn a cut along the haft and out past the open edge.

name: Toxinpeen
description: Hook the beak and pull the foe toward the open edge where his footing is poor.

name: Tempered Cheekplate
description: Fall upon the foe from the edge of his sight with the weight of the hammer and the wind.

name: Hour Hammerblow
description: Press the foe back to the edge with hammer and wind so his heels leave solid ground.

name: Booming Anvilfall
description: Drop the hammer from the open edge with the wind's full power and end the exchange at once.

name: Hammerface Fortitude
description: Stand braced like a rider caught in a squall with the hammer held across the front.

name: Sanguine Tamp
description: Rap the foe's guard in a sudden quick burst and withdraw before he answers.

name: Hammerblow Hardihood
description: Hook the beak in a sudden gust to snatch at a weapon or strap.

name: Might Peenside
description: Run in a short burst that carries the hammer to the foe before his guard is set.

name: Veritysmith
description: Hold still in the lull between gusts and sense the moment the foe's guard drops.

name: Decimating Eyehole
description: Throw a gust of qi into the head so the blow arrives heavy and with no warning.

name: Gustanvil
description: Spin the hammer in a gust so a heavy cut is thrown aside and the head comes round.

name: Gusttamp
description: Crush down with a driven gust of qi that carries the head through a raised guard.

name: Harnessing Spikeback
description: Pull with the beak in a sudden gust so the foe is dragged off his feet.

name: Daybreak Cheekplate
description: Slam the hammer so a burst of squall qi flings every foe near the blow off his feet.

name: Gyve Clawside
description: Bear down with head and haft in a steady squall until the foe's weapon arm is pinned.

name: Grievous Rumble Peenbite
description: Fall upon the foe with the sudden full force of the squall and break the guard and the body.

name: Thornanvil
description: Hold the hammer across the saddle and chest with the rein hand low and ready.

name: Sanguine Faceplate
description: Reach down from the saddle and rap a foot soldier on the helm as the mount passes.

name: Gustpeen
description: Step on the ground in time with the hoofbeat so the rider and the walker move as one.

name: Iron Beakpick
description: Drop the hammer from the saddle with qi and the speed of the gallop in the head.

name: Flintlike Anvilback
description: Turn a spear thrust with the haft while the mount swerves out of its line.

name: Toxin Hammerneck
description: Hook the beak into a foe's collar at the gallop and haul him from his feet.

name: Merciless Tamp
description: Charge across the plateau and let the speed of the mount and the qi gather in one blow.

name: Faceplate Ruin
description: Sweep the hammer wide at the gallop so that foes on foot beside the path are knocked down.

name: Rumble Hammerblow
description: Gather the speed of the mount and the full field of qi into one blow that breaks shield and arm.

name: Aegis Eyehole
description: Stand light on the toes as if an updraft held the hammer up and ready to fall.

name: Peenruin
description: Rap upward under the foe's guard with the poll as the hammer rises on the wind.

name: Faceplate Hardihood
description: Hook the beak over a foe's weapon and let the hammer's fall pull it down.

name: Torrent Drivehome
description: Rise on one pace and drop on the next so the body weight falls into the swing.

name: Mangling Hammerface
description: Raise the head with qi on an updraft and strike up under the chin of the helm.

name: Evergreen Cheekplate
description: Let the hammer fall across an incoming blade and turn it into the ground.

name: Ruinous Drivehome
description: Carry a heavy rising blow into a foe's raised guard and crush it against his face.

name: Blazesmith
description: Ride the updraft to the top of the arc and bring the hammer down with qi behind it.

name: Anvilback Reckoning
description: Hold the hammer pressed on the foe and let qi and wind drive him slowly to his knees.

name: Merciless Spikeback
description: Pair the lift of the updraft with the weight of the downfall in one blow that breaks any guard.

name: Aegis Peenside
description: Stand firm in a stance sworn to hold until the blow is finished and the foe is down.

name: Rumblesmith
description: Rap along the full length of the foe's weapon to learn where the hammer may reach.

name: Mayhem Forge
description: Hook the beak along a long bearing and draw the foe's weapon wide of his body.

name: Might Peenbite
description: Step slowly into the gale and hold ground against its push while the hammer waits.

name: Hammerface Durance
description: Hold the haft to the gale and let a blow slip off along the curve of the wood.

name: Might Hammerblow
description: Strike with qi held long in the haft so the blow keeps driving after the first impact.

name: Tempered Tamp
description: Crush down with the gale held in the head so the blow does not stop at the plate.

name: Peenspine
description: Hook a foe and keep him tethered to the blow so that he cannot slip away.

name: Sanguine Anvilfall
description: Fall upon the foe in the long unbroken swing of the oath and break whatever guard he has set.

name: Thorntamp
description: Press the head upon a foe and hold him in place with the held gale until the oath is done.

name: Anvilscourge
description: Release the gale held through the long oath in one blow that carries through all its length.
